resumeText: Aria Patel is a Cloud Engineer at Larkspur Financial with two years of experience automating AWS infrastructure. She writes Terraform and Python to provision environments, keeps Linux workloads healthy, and applies IAM and security best practices. Her networking work so far has relied on default VPC setups, and she is actively working to deepen her network design and large-scale infrastructure skills.
